sentences.text: Judgment
(Delivered on 16-01-2024)

1. Present Revision Petition is directed against order of Ld. Trial Court dated 23.08.2023 dismissing application u/S 156(3) Cr.PC and directing the petitioner to lead pre summoning evidence evidence.

2. Facts leading to filing of the petition are that the petitioner filed a complaint before SHO PS Ashok Vihar as well as other higher authorities alleging that the respondent no. 1 to 5 are running a racket of extortion from PS Ashok Vihar and the petitioner is victim of that extortion.

3. It was alleged in the complaint that R1 had registered a false FIR no. 578/2021 u/S 376/34 IPC against the complainant, who had never come to Delhi and after that started blackmailing the complainant.
The complainant was arrested in that FIR and when complainant produced the evidence before the court how he was CR. No.433/2023 Dalip Singh Vs. Rubi & Ors.
Page no.2 of 4 blackmailed the complainant was granted bail by the court
. Thereafter despite repeated request to the IOs of FIR no. 578/21, to investigate the matter fairly, the complainant was not heard.

It was also alleged that on 26.11.2021 at the time of arrest R2 and R3 demanded hush money of Rs.
50,000/- from complainant and on non payment he was given beatings in PS.
4.
As the police did not registered FIR petitioner approached Ld. MM u/S 156 (3) Cr.PC.

LD. MM Called for report in which IO Inspector Viswhanath reported that the FIR n. 578/21 was registered on complaint of R1 in which she stated that she was raped by complainant Deepak after intoxicating her.
He had taken R1 to a hotel on pretext of providing the job and while committing rape made video of R1 and after that on the basis of video repeatedly blackmailed her to have sexual relationship.
R1 later got selected as Constable in Delhi Police and came to Delhi however, the petitioner kept on pressurizing her for sexual favours on the basis of video and raped her.
Yet he circulated the video of R1 in the locality and made it viral.
The R1 filed the complaint only after the video became viral.
5. As the petitioner had provided one audio recording of R1 with his relative, it was inquired and found that R1 had demanded money for settlement.

6. The transcripts of audio recording are filed on record with a pen drive containing the audio Dalip Singh vs Rubi on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/22316850/
2 recording.
7.
This audio recording and the transcript shows that R1 had asked for money because she has been defamed and agree to state in favour of petitioner if she is paid money.

sentences.text: Page no.3 of 4 8.
Ld. MM had dismissed the application holding that nothing is to be recovered or discovered from alleged persons and all the facts and evidences are within reach of petitioner.
Ld. MM rightly observed that the complaint is filed just to put pressure on R1.
The transcript also shows that it was the relative of petitioner who had called R1 and in that conversation R1 had agreed to settle for consideration.
It was, therefore, a trap made against R1 so that petitioner can take advantage of same in bail.
Infact the petitioner became successful in getting bail on the basis of these recordings.
9. In these circumstances I find no ground for interference in the oder passed by Ld. Trial Court as it does not suffer from any illegality.
Hence the revision is dismissed.
10. File be consigned to Record Room.
Copy of this judgment be sent to ld. Trial Court alongwith TCR.
